notes: TEF Entrepreneurship Programme is a Tony Elumelu Foundation training-and-seed-capital programme, not a degree programme. Official page (tonyelumelufoundation.org/tef-entrepreneurship-programme) confirms mentorship via the TEF Mentor Guild of business professionals and masterclasses with industry experts - no university professors or academic supervisors are attached. Foundation-wide scheme with no attached institution.

Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program is a central foundation scheme delivered through a network of 62 partner universities/NGOs. Official page (mastercardfdn.org) states 'The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program is managed through our partner universities and non-governmental organizations... please apply through one of the partner universities' and that PhD scholarships are not offered. No supervising professors are attached at programme level; supervision would depend on the individual partner institution chosen, which is not fixed by this scholarship.

Inlaks Shivdasani Fellowship for Social Engagement is a non-degree, self-directed foundation fellowship (inlaksfoundation.org). Fellows pursue individual social-engagement projects in India; those enrolled in academic studies/PhD for the duration are explicitly excluded. Contact is fellowships@inlaksfoundation.org; no academic supervisors or professors are attached.

RISE Germany is a DAAD government-funded scheme (funded by the German Federal Foreign Office, daad.de/rise/en/rise-germany). Students are 'matched with a host university or institute according to their area of interest' after application; no specific host professors are published on the official programme page. National/government scheme with no attached institution.

FES Grundförderung für Ausländer:innen is a Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung foundation-wide scholarship for Bachelor's/Master's/Diplom/Staatsexamen study at any German state or state-recognised university. Official page (fes.de) lists only FES scholarship-office contact staff (Elisabeth Schulze Horn, Rebecca Schmitz), not supervising professors. No attached institution.

Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung refugee scholarship is a foundation-wide scheme (Bachelor/Master/PhD at German universities, applications via campus.kas.de). Direct fetch of https://www.kas.de/de/web/begabtenfoerderung-und-kultur/stipendien-fuer-gefluechtete returned HTTP 403 (blocked), but page content was confirmed via search-engine snippets of the same kas.de URL: support amounts, selection criteria, and 'individual support and consultations... by the staff of the Graduate Student Support Department of the KAS as well as by special academic advisors at your university' - advisors are not named professors tied to the scholarship. Foundation scheme with no attached institution.

Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS) is a DAAD scholarship-database listing (daad.de/go/en/stipa50076777) for development-related Master's/PhD courses across many German universities. Applications go directly to the chosen postgraduate course; no supervising professors are named on the official DAAD page. Government/database scheme with no attached institution.
